Satellite jobs, Monday Oct 26: None of the three companies posted new roles since last night. Five Amazon Leo roles came down: Sr. PMT, NTN Automotive/IoT, Amazon Leo, Redmond, WA VAT Manager, Digital and Devices Tax, London Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Leo, Bengaluru Processing Technician, 2nd Shift, Amazon Leo, Merritt Island, FL Corporate Counsel, Amazon Leo, London That leaves 1,086 open roles in total: Amazon Leo has 996 roles. Most are in hardware (316) and software development (234). Redmond (530) and Bellevue (140) have the most. Telesat has 53 roles. Most are on Lightspeed user terminals and integration work, and 35 are in Ottawa. Of the 53, 32 are hybrid, 17 are on-site, and 4 are remote. Eutelsat, including OneWeb, has 37 roles. They're mostly in finance, IT, and engineering, and 18 are near Paris, with others in London and Turin. The full list with links is in the attached spreadsheet.
